changeSet.author: felixm@inkomoko.com
changeSet.comment: Grant UPDATE_PROVISIONCATEGORY to any role that can already CREATE categories (excluding ALL_FUNCTIONS-bearing roles resolved via wildcard)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT DISTINCT rp.role_id, up.id FROM m_role_permission rp JOIN m_permission cp ON cp.id = rp.permission_id AND cp.code = 'CREATE_PROVISIONCATEGORY' CROSS JOIN m_permission up ON up.code = 'UPDATE_PROVISIONCATEGORY' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission erp JOIN m_permission ep ON ep.id = erp.permission_id AND ep.code = 'UPDATE_PROVISIONCATEGORY' WHERE erp.role_id = rp.role_id )

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Backfill null created_date on version rows from lastmodified_date or parent criteria
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_provisioning_criteria_version pcv JOIN m_provisioning_criteria pc ON pc.id = pcv.criteria_id SET pcv.created_date = COALESCE(pcv.created_date, pcv.lastmodified_date, pc.created_date) WHERE pcv.created_date IS NULL;

UPDATE m_provisioning_criteria_version pcv SET created_date = COALESCE(pcv.created_date, pcv.lastmodified_date, pc.created_date) FROM m_provisioning_criteria pc WHERE pc.id = pcv.criteria_id AND pcv.created_date IS NULL;
